_note: Approximate building boxes in the real city art, as fractions of the image (x, y, w, h; same convention as data/cities.json). Measured by eye on a 5% grid over the 1280x720 files. The occupied image was painted from the day image with the same camera, so one set of boxes fits both; differences are listed under ruined_differences. Ids match the hotspot ids in data/cities.json. For the story agent to align hotspots; nothing reads this file at runtime.
